_comment: Baseline supply-chain advisory allowlist. Each entry is an npm-audit advisory ACCEPTED after the triage in docs/audits (SECURITY-AUDIT-dependencies.md). The audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) fails CI on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here — i.e. a NEW vulnerable dependency entering the tree. Re-triage and update this file when bumping deps.

_categories.dev-build-only: Dev/build/test tooling only; never shipped in the deployed relay, indexer, or browser bundle.
_categories.not-reachable: Present transitively but not reachable in Morphit usage (see SECURITY-AUDIT-dependencies.md triage): SSRF validator does not use ip-address; dompurify/sanitize-html unused by Morphit code; @hono/node-server bug is Windows-only; the request-family transport is only used by the matrix-bot against a FIXED operator-configured homeserver (no attacker input).
_categories.runtime-accepted: Runtime dependency with low real exposure; no directly-exploitable path in the deployed key-handling/core logic. Patch when convenient; not release-blocking.
